scope: Actual JavaScript module tests with deterministic network, storage, worker and pixel mocks. No browser or live-network timing benchmark.

tests.name: Current face precedes directional neighbors and inactive cards
Shared requests and fast scroll reversal do not duplicate current decode
Cancelling a stale cap cannot cancel a card sharing its transfer
Focused slice preempts lower-priority transfers when slots are occupied
Pausing cancels speculative work but preserves an explicit current request
Save-data and slow connections constrain speculative work
Hidden tab stops background transfers and visibility restores the window
Decoded cache has a hard byte budget and keeps the selected face
Neighborhood plan is local, byte-limited and never walks the full volume
Whole-organ focus warms current cards without selecting an arbitrary cap
Background errors back off, explicit retry works, and observers cannot strand loads
Pause and consumer cancellation also work during initial metadata loading
Empty source records retain exact registration without a network fetch
Encoded memory and persistent caches evict by byte budget
Persistent-cache denial falls back to bounded memory without failing images
Actual fetch backend streams exact bytes, reuses encoded cache and rejects truncation
Decoder preserves every grayscale sample and releases bitmap resources
Unavailable Worker falls back to the same exact-image backend
Actual module worker returns transferred pixels and forwards progress
